_README: SessionStart hook snippet for the core cartridge loader (scripts/cartridge_loader.py) — TRACKED source.
install-wizard discovers every templates/settings.*.snippet.json and merges it into the project's
.claude/settings.json only after the user answers Y to its SessionStart step; this file itself registers nothing.
What the hook does: reads the operator's enabled list ($FH_CARTRIDGES_ENABLED, else
$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/cartridges.enabled), and for each line whose admitted snapshot still hashes to the
listed sha256, adds that cartridge's skill text to the session context. kind: activity cartridges are skipped
(they route themselves). No list = nothing injected, one stderr line. Always exits 0. Writes nothing.
